legal_privacy_head_description: What Kosha stores about you, what it never does with your financial data, and which services it relies on.
legal_privacy_intro: This policy covers the Kosha service at getkosha.app. Kosha is open source, and anyone can run their own copy. A copy you or someone else runs is outside this policy: whoever runs it is responsible for the data in it.
legal_privacy_short_yours: Your financial data is yours. It is not sold, rented, shared for advertising or used to train models.
legal_privacy_short_no_ads: There are no ads, no analytics, no tracking pixels and no third-party cookies.
legal_privacy_short_ai: AI features are off unless you add your own provider key, and you choose what they may see.
legal_privacy_short_export: You can export everything, or delete your account and all its data, from Settings at any time.
legal_privacy_stores_account: {#strong}Your account:{/strong} your name, email address, a hash of your password (never the password itself), passkeys, two-factor settings and an optional profile picture. If you sign in with Google, Kosha also keeps your Google account id, your Google profile picture's address and the tokens Google returns, encrypted.
legal_privacy_stores_finances: {#strong}Your finances:{/strong} everything you enter or import, such as accounts, transactions, payees, categories, tags, events, subscriptions, reconciliations, statement imports and attached receipts or payslips.
legal_privacy_stores_sessions: {#strong}Sign-in sessions:{/strong} for each signed-in device, the IP address and browser name it signed in with, so you can see and end sessions. Sessions expire after 30 days without use.
legal_privacy_stores_security: {#strong}Security records:{/strong} IP addresses are counted for a short time to limit repeated sign-in attempts and API requests.
legal_privacy_stores_api: {#strong}API keys and connected apps:{/strong} keys you create and apps you connect through the MCP server. Keys are stored hashed.
legal_privacy_stores_ai: {#strong}AI settings:{/strong} provider keys you add, stored encrypted, and a record of each AI request's token counts for Settings › AI › AI usage. When Keep a request log is on, the request and reply are kept for 30 days. Each log row is deleted after 62 days.
legal_privacy_why_body: Data is used only to run Kosha for you: to sign you in, keep your account secure, show your totals and run the features you turn on. The legal basis is the agreement to provide the service you sign up for, and the legitimate interest in keeping it secure and free of abuse.
legal_privacy_ai_body: AI features use a provider key you add yourself, such as Anthropic or OpenAI. When you use one, Kosha sends that provider only what Settings › AI › What AI can see allows, and hidden payees and account references are replaced with codes first. The provider handles that request under its own terms and privacy policy, which you accept when you create a key with them. Kosha has no AI key of its own and never sends your data to an AI provider you did not set up.
legal_privacy_services_cloudflare: {#strong}Cloudflare{/strong} hosts the app, its database (D1) and file storage (R2), and processes every request, including short-lived request logs used to fix errors. Data may be processed in any country where Cloudflare operates.
legal_privacy_services_rates: {#strong}Exchange rates{/strong} come from the public fawazahmed0 currency API through jsDelivr. Kosha's server fetches them; no data about you is sent.
legal_privacy_services_api_reference: {#strong}The API reference page{/strong} loads its viewer from jsDelivr, which sees your IP address like any website you load files from.
legal_privacy_services_google: {#strong}Google{/strong}, only if you choose to sign in with it. Google tells Kosha your name, email address and profile picture, and learns that you signed in to Kosha.
legal_privacy_services_better_auth: {#strong}Better Auth{/strong}, which makes Kosha's sign-in system, runs the dashboard Kosha uses to manage accounts. It receives your name, email address, sign-in activity, IP address and browser details, and your browser sends it a device fingerprint to help stop account abuse. It never sees your accounts, transactions or other finance data.
legal_privacy_services_email: {#strong}An email provider{/strong}, only when you ask to reset your password. Kosha sends it your email address and the reset email, which holds a link that works once, for one hour. Kosha sends no other email.
legal_privacy_services_ai: {#strong}AI providers{/strong} you add yourself, as described above.
legal_privacy_cookies_title: Cookies and storage on your device
legal_privacy_cookies_body: Kosha sets only the cookies it needs to keep you signed in, to remember the language you picked and, if you choose, to remember a trusted device for two-factor sign-in. Because these are strictly necessary, there is no cookie banner. The browser also keeps a few preferences, such as your theme and last-used account, and entries you add while offline until they are sent. When installed as an app, Kosha saves pages and data on your device so it works offline. Signing out clears the saved pages.
legal_privacy_retention_body: Your data is kept while your account exists. Deleting your account in Settings › Delete & reset removes your financial data, profile picture and attachments straight away. Copies in the database provider's point-in-time recovery expire within 30 days. The shared demo account holds invented data only.
legal_privacy_rights_body: Depending on where you live, laws such as the GDPR give you the right to access, correct, export and delete your data, and to object to or restrict how it is used. Most of these you can do yourself:
legal_privacy_rights_correct: Correct anything by editing it in the app.
legal_privacy_rights_export: Export your data as CSV or JSON in Settings › Import & export.
legal_privacy_rights_delete: Delete your account and all its data in Settings › Delete & reset.
legal_privacy_rights_sessions: End sessions and disconnect apps in Settings › Sign-in & security and Settings › API & MCP.
legal_privacy_rights_other: For anything else, contact the maintainer (below). You can also complain to your local data protection authority.
legal_privacy_security_body: Traffic is encrypted with HTTPS. Passwords are hashed, AI provider keys are encrypted, and every query is scoped to your account. No system is perfectly secure. If you find a vulnerability, please report it privately to the maintainer rather than in a public issue.
legal_privacy_children_body: Kosha is not meant for children under 16, and does not knowingly hold their data.
legal_privacy_changes_body: When this policy changes, the date at the top changes too, and the full history is public in the {#source}source repository{/source}.
legal_privacy_contact_body: Kosha is run by Amruth Pillai. For privacy questions or requests, use the contact details on {#maintainer}the maintainer's GitHub profile{/maintainer}. For anything that is not private, open an issue on {#github}GitHub{/github}.
legal_terms_head_description: The terms for using the hosted Kosha service at getkosha.app.
legal_terms_intro: These terms cover your use of the Kosha service at getkosha.app, run by Amruth Pillai. By creating an account or using the service, you agree to them and to the {#privacy}privacy policy{/privacy}. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
legal_terms_service_body: Kosha is a free personal finance tracker. It records what you enter or import; it does not connect to your bank, move money or make payments. The service may change, gain or lose features, or pause for maintenance. If it is ever shut down, there will be reasonable notice so you can export your data.
legal_terms_code_body: Kosha's source code is published under the {#license}MIT licence{/license}. These terms cover the hosted service only. If you run your own copy, the licence applies and these terms do not.
legal_terms_account_age: You must be at least 16 and able to agree to these terms where you live.
legal_terms_account_one: One account per person. Give a real email address and keep it up to date.
legal_terms_account_keys: Keep your password, passkeys, backup codes and API keys safe. You are responsible for what happens in your account and through the keys and apps you connect to it.
legal_terms_account_demo: The shared demo account is read-only and holds invented data. Do not put real information in it.
legal_terms_data_body: What you put into Kosha stays yours. You allow Kosha to store and process it only to run the service for you. You can export it or delete it at any time from Settings. Keep your own exports if the data matters to you: the service is run with care, but backups are not guaranteed.
legal_terms_use_law: break the law, or upload content you have no right to store;
legal_terms_use_access: try to reach another person's data, or probe, scan or attack the service;
legal_terms_use_overload: overload the service, get around its rate limits, or use it to host files unrelated to your finances;
legal_terms_use_resell: resell the service, or use it to run finances on behalf of others as a business.
legal_terms_use_enforcement: Accounts that break these rules may be suspended or deleted, with notice where reasonable.
legal_terms_api_body: The REST API and MCP server are part of the service and fall under these terms, including their rate limits. AI features use a provider key you add yourself. Your use of that provider, and any cost it charges, is between you and the provider under its terms. AI answers can be wrong; check them before you rely on them.
legal_terms_advice_body: Kosha shows your own records back to you. Nothing in it is financial, tax, investment or legal advice. Exchange rates are daily reference rates, not the rates your bank charges, and totals are only as accurate as the data you enter. Check anything important against your bank's statements.
legal_terms_warranty_body: The service is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose, accuracy or uninterrupted availability.
legal_terms_liability_body: To the fullest extent the law allows, the operator of Kosha is not liable for any indirect, incidental or consequential loss, or for loss of data, profits or savings, arising from your use of the service. Because the service is free, total liability for any claim is limited to zero, or the lowest amount the law allows. Nothing here limits liability that cannot be limited by law, such as for intent or gross negligence, or your rights as a consumer.
legal_terms_ending_body: You can stop at any time by deleting your account in Settings › Delete & reset. The service may end an account that breaks these terms. Sections that by their nature should last, such as the warranty and liability sections, continue after an account ends.
legal_terms_changes_body: When these terms change, the date at the top changes too, and the full history is public in the {#source}source repository{/source}. Using the service after a change means you accept the new terms.
legal_terms_contact_body: For questions about these terms, use the contact details on {#maintainer}the maintainer's GitHub profile{/maintainer}, or open an issue on {#github}GitHub{/github}.
